## Design note

The beater-tier hero: light, eager and cheap to fix. It is slow in a straight line but carries speed through traffic, and its high-revving four rewards keeping it above the cam crossover. Front-heavy FF balance with a stiff rear bar gives lift-off rotation for players who learn it; everyone else gets safe understeer.

## How this car breaks

Thin 90s unibody with modest crumple zones. Plastic bumpers and the steel hood crumple at parking-lot speeds; the transverse engine sits right behind the radiator so a 40 km/h nose hit already cooks the cooling pack. The cabin is acceptable for its era but the A-pillars fold in a hard offset hit, so in Simulation one committed frontal at speed is the end of it.

## Sources (type)

- manufacturer spec-class data for late-90s 1.6 L FF hatches (mass, dimensions, gearing)
- owner chassis-dyno averages for the high-rev two-stage-cam 1.6 engine family
- engineering tables: tire size → radius, ride-frequency spring sizing, brake torque from caliper hydraulics

All values are class-typical figures for the archetype, rounded; no single real vehicle is reproduced.

## Inertia

Box approximation about the CG, scaled for mass concentration (`k < 1`: mass near the centre, e.g. mid-engine; `k → 1`: mass at the ends):

```
I_roll  = k_r · m·(W² + H²)/12
I_pitch = k_p · m·(L² + H²)/12
I_yaw   = k_y · m·(W² + L²)/12
```

| pitch | 1787 | 0.90 | 1610 |

Peak **103 kW @ 7000 rpm**, **152 N·m @ 6000 rpm**. Idle 800 / redline 7600 / limiter 7900 rpm. Rotating inertia 0.10 kg·m² (class: 0.10 small four … 0.30 big-block). Engine braking 12% of peak torque = 18 N·m. Power-to-weight 93 kW/t.

## Drivetrain

5-speed manual, open front differential. Layout **FWD**; front diff: open; rear diff: open. Clutch capacity 1.40 × peak torque = 210 N·m. Shift time 0.45 s.

| Gear | Ratio | Overall | km/h @ redline |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 3.23 | 14.21 | 58 |
| 2 | 1.90 | 8.36 | 99 |
| 3 | 1.27 | 5.59 | 148 |
| 4 | 0.97 | 4.27 | 194 |
| 5 | 0.78 | 3.43 | 241 |

Final drive 4.40, reverse 3.00. Speeds use the driven-wheel loaded radius 0.289 m.

## Suspension

Springs from ride frequency, `k = m_s·(2πf)²` with sprung corner mass `m_s = axle load/2 − unsprung`; dampers `c = 2ζ·√(k·m_s)`, ζ = 0.30 bump, rebound = 1.5 × bump.

| Axle | m_s | f | Wheel rate k | Bump c | Rebound c | Travel |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| Front | 326 kg | 1.55 Hz | 30900 N/m | 1900 N·s/m | 2850 N·s/m | 0.16 m |
| Rear | 195 kg | 1.70 Hz | 22200 N/m | 1250 N·s/m | 1880 N·s/m | 0.17 m |

Round 12b ride rule (A): the file carries the derived dampers × 1.2 bump / × 1.6 rebound (rebound ≈ 2 × bump), after any tunes below: **2280 / 4560 N·s/m F, 1500 / 3010 N·s/m R** (bump / rebound).

Anti-roll bars from a roll-gradient target of 3.0°/g with 42% of roll stiffness at the front. Roll arm h − h_rc = 0.405 m (roll centres 0.08 m F / 0.12 m R). Required total K_φ = m·g·arm/φ = 84051 N·m/rad; springs give k·t²/2 = 33589 F / 24148 R N·m/rad; bars supply the rest as `arb_n_per_m = K_bar/t²` = **800 F / 11300 R N/m** (clamped at ≥ 0). Resulting gradient 3.0°/g, front share 42%. Bump stops 150000 N/m.

Alignment: camber -0.5° F / -1.0° R, toe +0.00° F / +0.15° R (+ = in), caster 3.0°.

## Brakes

Full-pedal line pressure 100 bar.

- Front: 262 mm disc, pistons per side 54 mm → A = 22.9 cm², r_eff = D/2 − 25 mm = 106 mm, pad μ = 0.38: T = 2·μ·p·A·r_eff = 2·0.38·100 bar·22.9 cm²·0.106 m = **1845 N·m**
- Rear: 239 mm disc, pistons per side 34 mm → A = 9.1 cm², r_eff = D/2 − 25 mm = 94 mm, pad μ = 0.38: T = 2·μ·p·A·r_eff = 2·0.38·100 bar·9.1 cm²·0.095 m = **652 N·m**

Lock check at 1 g on μ = 1 (load transfer m·a·h/L): front needs 1273 N·m/wheel (capacity 1.45×), rear needs 297 N·m/wheel (capacity 2.19×).

`wp_vehicle` gives the axle `bias_front` favours its full `max_torque_*` and scales the other by (1 − b)/b, so `max_torque_*` holds the caliper capacity per wheel and `bias_front` acts as the proportioning valve: the rear is trimmed to the same lock margin as the front (ideal rear = T_f · lock_r/lock_f = 432 N·m), never boosted above its caliper capacity. Rear capacity exceeds that, so `bias_front` = T_r/(T_r + ideal) = **0.601** → delivered 1850 N·m front / 432 N·m rear per wheel at full pedal. Handbrake 900 N·m per rear wheel.

## Steering

Ratio 15.0:1. Kerb-to-kerb turning circle 10.0 m → outer-front path radius 4.90 m, rear-axle-centre radius 3.41 m → mean road-wheel lock δ = atan(L/R) = **0.656 rad (37.6°)** (outer 32.3°, inner 44.5° at full Ackermann; `ackermann_frac` 0.70). Rack speed 1.5 rad/s.
